title: Embed Hyperlinks and Accessible Images
task: Add a clickable hyperlink and an accessible image. Use an `` element with a valid `href` attribute, and an `` element that has both a `src` attribute and a descriptive non-empty `alt` attribute.
hints: Create an `<a>` tag with an `href` attribute, such as `href="https://example.com"`.
Add an `` tag with both `src="https://..."` and `alt="..."` attributes.
